name: Somalia National Data Center (Mogadishu)
developer: Federal Government of Somalia / Ministry of Communications and Technology (MOCT)
notes: MOCT reports the Federal Communications and Technology Minister inspected construction progress of the National Data Center in Mogadishu on May 6, 2025; an earlier April 2024 MOCT news item also describes a ministerial tour of the facility. DC Byte lists it as a self-build public-sector facility by MoCT under construction. No public capacity figure was found.

name: OADC Mogadishu data center
developer: Open Access Data Centres (OADC) / WIOCC Group
notes: DCD reported (Nov 24, 2021) that WIOCC's new Open Access Data Centres unit would develop a carrier-neutral data center at its Mogadishu submarine cable landing as one of three first-phase locations (with Lagos and Durban), targeted to be ready before the end of 2022 following a $200m capital raise. No public evidence of completion was found in this pass, so status is retained as announced.

name: Hormuud Telecom data center network (11 sites, solar-powered)
notes: Garowe Online reported (Dec 10, 2024) that Hormuud Telecom, headquartered in Mogadishu, operates 11 data centers with an aggregate capacity described as 10 megawatt-hours (approx. 10 MW), 95% sourced from solar panels, and plans expansion to support AI workloads. The article does not list individual site locations; the Mogadishu/Banaadir hub is the operator's base, and facilities may also serve other divisions. Capacity figure is approximate per the source.

name: Eurosom Data Center / cloud infrastructure (Mogadishu)
notes: Eurosom markets itself as Somalia's first enterprise-grade cloud provider with operational hubs in London, Sharjah and Mogadishu, and LinkedIn posts describe an 'Eurosom data center' in Mogadishu. These are company marketing materials with no independent capacity or facility specification, so status is marked unknown and evidence is weak.

name: ATAL Networks Mogadishu VPS data center
notes: ATAL Networks markets a 'Mogadishu data center' for VPS hosting in Somalia. This appears to be a small hosting provider/reseller claim with no independent verification, no facility specification, and no capacity data, so it is retained only as unverified evidence.

Targeted searches for Awdal, Borama and Zeila with data center/datacenter/server farm/colocation terms found no public facility or project. Baxtel's Somalia market overview tracks only Wingu Africa Berbera SL01 (Berbera lies in the Sahil region, attributed to the Northwest division in batch-593, not Awdal), confirming no tracked commercial datacenter in Awdal.

Targeted searches for Bakool and its towns (Hudur, Rab Dhuure, El Barde) with data center/datacenter/server farm terms found no public evidence of a datacenter project. Somalia-wide market listings (Baxtel) track only the Berbera facility outside this division.

Searches for Bosaso and Puntland found no public datacenter facility. Golis Telecom (Puntland's main operator, based in Bosaso) operates telecom exchange/'center' branches across Puntland towns but no publicly documented datacenter or colocation facility. Hormuud's nationwide data center fleet is HQ'd in Mogadishu and no Bari site is documented.

Targeted searches for Bay and Baidoa with data center/datacenter/server farm terms found only telecom (Hormuud 5G launch in Baidoa) and unrelated infrastructure projects (water/sanitation, health), with no public datacenter facility or project in the division.

Targeted searches for Galguduud and Dhusamareb found telecom coverage references (e.g., Hormuud 5G in Dhusamareb) but no public datacenter facility, server farm, hyperscale, or colocation project in the division.

Targeted searches for Gedo and its towns (Garbahaarey, Doolow, Luuq, Bardera) with data center/datacenter/server farm terms found no public evidence of a datacenter project. Somalia-wide market listings track only the Berbera facility.

Targeted searches for Hiiraan and Beledweyne found telecom coverage references (Hormuud 5G in Beledweyne) and unrelated development projects (e.g., UNOPS urban services, Nagaad ESMP) but no public datacenter facility or project in the division.
Targeted searches for Middle Juba and Bu'ale found no public evidence of any datacenter, server farm, hyperscale, or colocation project. Somalia-wide market listings track only the Berbera facility.

Targeted searches for Lower Juba and Kismayo found telecom connectivity references (Hormuud 5G in Kismayo) but no public datacenter facility, server farm, hyperscale, or colocation project in the division.
